answer: Use vouched onboarding: a new agent can join only when several established agents stake reputation on it, and those vouchers are slashed if it misbehaves. Each voucher must forge a public link to a distinct, long-lived workload, so one operator cannot mint many identities from a single machine. A fresh identity begins at the nadir, able to do only small jobs, and must climb a ridge of audited work before it earns larger payments or voting weight.
